! BEGIN CONTROLLERS
controller controller-a
  management-ip 10.0.0.10
  cluster-name cluster-a
  role active
  ha-peer controller-b
  site site-a
  description primary
exit
controller controller-b
  management-ip 10.0.0.11
  cluster-name cluster-a
  role standby
  ha-peer controller-a
  site site-a
exit
! END CONTROLLERS
! BEGIN SWITCHES
switch leaf-1
  management-ip 10.0.0.1
  role filter
  site site-a
  model 7050
exit
switch leaf-2
  management-ip 10.0.0.2
  role delivery
  site site-a
exit
! END SWITCHES
! BEGIN INTERFACES
interface leaf-1 ethernet1
  role filter
  description capture
  speed 10g
  vlan 100
  enabled true
exit
interface leaf-2 ethernet2
  role delivery
  description tool
  speed 10g
  enabled true
exit
! END INTERFACES
! BEGIN GROUPS
interface-group collectors
  role filter
  member leaf-1:ethernet1
exit
! END GROUPS
! BEGIN SERVICE NODES
service-node service-a
  switch leaf-1
  interface ethernet1
  management-ip 10.0.0.20
exit
! END SERVICE NODES
! BEGIN ANALYTICS NODES
analytics-node analytics-a
  switch leaf-1
  interface ethernet1
  management-ip 10.0.0.21
exit
! END ANALYTICS NODES
! BEGIN RECORDER NODES
recorder-node recorder-a
  switch leaf-1
  interface ethernet1
  management-ip 10.0.0.22
exit
! END RECORDER NODES
! BEGIN FABRIC SETTINGS
fabric-settings fabric-a
  syslog 10.0.0.30
  ntp 10.0.0.31
  snmp-community public
  enable-password generated-enable
  api-token generated-token
exit
! END FABRIC SETTINGS
! BEGIN POLICIES
policy policy-a
  priority 100
  action forward
  enabled true
  description mirror traffic
  source-interface leaf-1:ethernet1
  delivery-interface leaf-2:ethernet2
  match-rule 10
    source-ip 10.0.0.1
    destination-ip 10.0.0.2
    source-port 80
    destination-port 443
    vlan 100
    protocol tcp
  exit
exit
! END POLICIES
